internalNote: Built from Kevin's own per-song extraction CSV (SHB1844_cumulative_extraction.csv), 242 songs, pages 27-260 - the original, first edition of The Sacred Harp (B. F. White and E. J. King). Copyright entered 1844 by White and King in the Clerk's Office of the District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania; stereotyped by L. Johnson, Philadelphia; printed by T. K. & P. G. Collins. Preface signed B. F. White, Hamilton, Harris County, Georgia, April 1844, with an additional note signed by both White and King. Structured in three parts: Part II begins on printed page 163 (principally singing-school and society pieces), Part III on printed page 225 (odes and anthems). The general index styles the page 240 title as "Christian's Song," but the tune-page heading itself reads "Christian Song" - the CSV, and this file, follow the tune-page heading. Gaps within the page range (concentrated from 219-259, inside Part III's odes and anthems) are consistent with longer, multi-page pieces whose interior pages don't receive their own row, matching the convention used throughout this extraction; the extraction's own record reports zero known gaps or open continuations. No index cross-check against the book's own printed index has been done yet; this is a first-pass build from the extraction CSV alone.

242.firstLine: The morning sun shines from the east, And spreads his glories to the west,

245.title: Claremont
245.firstLine: Vital spark of heav’nly flame, Quit, oh! quit this mortal frame;

250.title: Heavenly Vision
250.firstLine: I beheld, and lo a great multitude, which no man could number;

254.title: Rose of Sharon
254.firstLine: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valley;

260.title: Farewell Anthem
260.firstLine: My friends, I am going a long and tedious journey, never to return.
